# 1.38.0-beta.5

The fifth beta brings model selection, favorites, and reasoning settings into a single menu.

## Model selection

- The provider, key, search, and filters sit above a full-width model list.
- Star models to save them to the active profile. Use the star filter to show favorites.
- OpenRouter filters cover routing shortcuts and available catalog variants.
- Picking a model keeps the menu open. Set reasoning effort, thinking, and speed there when supported. The selected model label includes the effective effort.

## Performance

- The menu renders the visible part of the list and prepares the next ten rows. Search covers the full catalog.
